name: flashcart
description: FlashCart — Smart Mall Billing & Unified Checkout System

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:https --prefix frontend"
